channel.title: Mozambique - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mozambique, every source cited.

item.title: Mozambique economic growth fails to cut poverty, says central bank
item.description: The governor of the Bank of Mozambique warned that public debt and limited credit hinder improvements in living conditions.

item.title: Nampula court suspends Praça do Metical construction
item.description: Civil society groups opposed the project's use of public parkland, prompting a legal review.

item.title: Mozambique forces face mobile insurgent tactics
item.description: Brigadier General Sérgio Estrela reported 154 attacks in five months across 16 districts, including Niassa.

item.title: Mozambique invites Russian firms to invest
item.description: President Daniel Chapo seeks Russian investment in agriculture, industry, and energy sectors for economic diversification.

item.title: EU-trained units struggle against Mozambique insurgents
item.description: Insurgents conducted 154 attacks in five months across 16 districts, while specialised forces are misused.
